title: A-B pair at separation 9, at rest: constant K_A(B) = 6.16 and K_B(A) = 8.70 at P = 2.5 (T <= 10)

claims.statement: One A and one B particle at rest, initial separation in [8.9, 9.1], observed for at most T = 10: A accelerates toward B with magnitude K_A(B) / r^2.5 and B toward A with magnitude K_B(A) / r^2.5 (r the current separation), with K_A(B) = 6.161 and K_B(A) = 8.695 held constant. These are trajectory-level constants at P = 2.5 for this start. The claim makes no statement about the functional form, the exponent, or other separations. K_B(A)/K_A(B) = 1.41. Out-of-sample error (fit on one orientation, predict the other, full T = 10) is 0.0051 and 0.0052 RMSE/L, at the tracker noise floor.
